purpose: Build a project from a strong-model roadmap graph by generating one unit per node and running each unblocked unit on the cheapest model that passes its checks.

sources.name: wayfinder
sources.ref: census/wayfinder.md (map, one question per ticket, type label, claim, blocking links, resolution record, hand-off)

sources.name: warp
sources.ref: task brief background only; no census file exists for Warp (scorers, improver, factory changed by reviewed diff)

invariants.statement: Every open unit issue carries exactly one node:<id> label naming a node in ROADMAP.md.
A claim file exists only for a unit whose every blocked_by issue is closed with a resolution record.
At most one claim file exists per unit; it is created by one pushed fleet-state transaction.
Every unit has exactly one type: label.
The nodes: block has no dependency cycle and no unknown id.
No PR is opened unless the code map check passes on its head.
A build changes only files matching the job's files_allowed.
No merge without a PASS verdict on the head sha and green CI.
No model job starts unless fleet budget allow <lane> exits 0.
Every issue, label, milestone and comment create goes through fleet ghq.
Every new command prints JSON and exits 0, or exits 75 for not now; any other exit is an error.
A change to this spec reaches main only through a PR the owner merges.
Every step that needs the owner raises exactly one waiting_item in Waiting on you, and no step asks him anywhere else.
